repository.name: opentyrian/opentyrian
repository.description: OpenTyrian is an open-source port of the DOS game Tyrian.
repository.originalDevelopers: Eclipse Software (Jason Emery, Alexander Brandon, Robert Allen)

architecture.description: Mengatur siklus game loop 60 FPS, state machine pergantian level, inisialisasi modul subsistem, dan handler menu arcade.
Porting render buffer VGA 320x200 256-warna ke SDL2 surface dengan filter upscaling hq2x / hq3x / scaleNx.
Emulasi chip AdLib YM3812 / Sound Blaster OPL2/OPL3 synthesizer dan pemutar format musik LOUDNESS (.LDS).
Algoritma tabrakan proyektil, pola pergerakan kapal musuh, sistem animasi partikel bintang latar, dan minigame rahasia DESTRUCT.

buildGuide.wasmSupport: Direwrite langsung ke Tyrian Web Engine (HTML5 Canvas + Web Audio) tanpa perlu build .EXE atau emulator DOS, serta mendukung kompilasi Emscripten WebAssembly & DOSBox.
